L01: (define-fun spec ((amount Int) (max_rate Int)) Bool (and (<= 0 amount) (<= amount max_rate)))
L02: (define-fun spec ((n Int) (max_rate Int)) Bool (and (<= 0 n) (<= n max_rate)))
L03: (define-fun spec ((limit Int) (used Int) (cost Int)) Bool (and (<= 0 used) (<= 0 cost) (<= (+ used cost) limit)))
L04: (define-fun spec ((requested Int) (available Int)) Bool (and (<= 0 requested) (<= 0 available) (<= requested available)))
L05: (define-fun spec ((k Int) (calls Int)) Bool (and (<= 0 k) (<= k calls)))
L07: (define-fun spec ((weight Int) (limit Int)) Bool (and (<= 0 limit) (> weight limit)))
L08: (define-fun spec ((n Int) (limit Int)) Bool (and (<= 0 n) (<= n limit)))
L09: (define-fun spec ((existing Int) (amount Int) (limit Int)) Bool (and (<= 0 existing) (<= 0 amount) (<= (+ existing amount) limit)))
L10: (define-fun spec ((n Int) (capacity Int)) Bool (and (<= 0 n) (<= n capacity) (<= 0 capacity)))
